0022600094.text: The Hornets host the Hawks in a game where neither team has played a 2026-27 game yet, and Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee). Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). In 2025-26 the Hornets won the season series 3-1, including a 110-107 regular-season win in Charlotte on February 11, 2026.
